title: The verified national record
description: Every AI use case running in Rwanda. Each entry reviewed against primary documentation and dated.
provenanceNote: Transcribed from the published record on 17 September 2026. The record renders its entries client-side, so they could not be fetched programmatically. Entry names, owners and stages are recorded as displayed; spellings of a few owner names and one institution could not be confirmed and are flagged. 42 of the 43 institutions were captured, one fell between screen captures. Replace this with a machine-readable export when one is available: scripts/ingest_raia_record.py accepts it directly.

taxonomy.stageNote: RAIA's five-stage lifecycle is finer than this platform's four. Mapping used: Concept and User research → proof of concept; Pilot/MVP → pilot; Scaling → production; Deployed at scale → scaled.

enablers.name: National Artificial Intelligence Policy
enablers.description: The founding document. Sets Rwanda's ambition for AI, the priority sectors, and the governance arrangements that everything in this record sits under.

enablers.name: AI Readiness and Maturity Framework for Rwanda
enablers.description: How readiness is measured across institutions, and what each maturity level requires before an institution can deploy.

enablers.name: National Data Sharing Policy
enablers.description: The rules for moving data between institutions. Most AI work in the record depends on this being resolved.

enablers.name: National Broadband Policy and Strategy
enablers.description: The connectivity floor that AI services depend on, and the targets against which coverage is tracked.

enablers.name: AI Playbook for Small States
enablers.description: Rwanda's playbook for how a small state builds AI capability without the budget of a large one.

enablers.name: Law on the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy
enablers.description: The binding legal constraint on any AI system in Rwanda that touches personal data.

enablers.description: The region's deepest concentration of graduate AI engineering training, and the pipeline most Rwandan AI teams recruit from.
